title: D* Lite vs A* from scratch for unknown-map replanning in the close-area arena
summary: D* Lite on the same inflated grid and cost model as astar_esdf's unknown-map mode, compared with A* replanning from scratch on 50 seed-0 layouts per family. Same outcomes (random, u_trap), identical path costs at all 10,017 frozen-map checks, 4-7x less search time per replan; on tiled maps A* search grows to 5.8 s (8x8 tiles) while D* Lite stays at 2.5-7 ms. Synthetic.
verified: 2026-11-09: compare run/verify/scale/fuzz ran on Apple M3 Max, CPython 3.12.10 (results/ files); README written afterwards from those files after the build run timed out.
shows: Incremental replanning (D* Lite) vs A* from scratch: same paths, 4-7x faster here, 800x faster on an 8x8 tiled map
key_result: [compare_0](README.md#results-seed-0-50-layouts-per-family): random reached 100 % both; search median 20.6 ms A* vs 3.2 ms D* Lite; 8x8 tiled map 5.8 s vs 7 ms
